description: Manages who can access a file. action=list shows the grants (id, type, role, emailAddress/domain, expirationTime, pendingOwner). action=share grants access: type=user/group (needs email_address), domain (needs domain), or anyone (link sharing; allow_file_discovery=true also makes it searchable); role=reader, commenter, writer, fileOrganizer/organizer (shared drives only) or owner. Sharing with a user emails them by default — send_notification_email=false suppresses it (not allowed for ownership transfers); email_message adds a note. action=update changes an existing grant's role (needs permission_id from list); action=remove revokes it. Ownership transfer: role=owner with transfer_ownership=true — between personal accounts this only INVITES the new owner (pendingOwner until they accept). Changes are live immediately; removing your own access to someone else's file is irreversible from your side. role=owner/organizer grants full control including permanent deletion — prefer writer or less.

action.description: What to do with the file's permissions.

allow_file_discovery.description: share with type=domain/anyone: whether the file can be FOUND by search (default false = link only).

domain.description: share with type=domain: the Workspace domain, e.g. example.com.

email_address.description: share with type=user/group: the grantee's email address.

email_message.description: share: a custom note for the notification email.

expiration_time.description: update: RFC3339 expiry for the grant, e.g. 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z (not available for owners).

file_id.description: The file id — the long id from the Drive URL (drive.google.com/file/d/<fileId> or docs.google.com/.../d/<fileId>/edit) or from search_files/get_file output. Folders and shared-drive items are files too.

page_token.description: list: nextPageToken from the previous page.

permission_id.description: update/remove: the permission id from action=list.

role.description: share/update: the access level. fileOrganizer/organizer exist only on shared drives; owner transfers ownership.

send_notification_email.description: share with type=user/group: send the notification email (API default true; must stay true for ownership transfer).

transfer_ownership.description: share with role=owner: confirm the ownership transfer (required by the API for role=owner).

type.description: share only: who the grant is for. user/group need email_address; domain needs domain; anyone = link sharing.
